target_customer: Small and mid sized service businesses such as law firms, healthcare clinics, real estate companies and childcare facilities
problem: Small service businesses spend many hours on administrative work inside legacy tools, such as drafting closing documents, scheduling and data entry.
business_model: subscription for specialized AI agents that operate inside a customer's existing apps and websites (pricing page exists, amounts not retrieved)
product_category: AI agents for small business back office work

founders.name: Ben Smith
education: dropped out of college at 20 (school not named)
founders.background_notes: YC bio says he used to sell shoes, trading cards and collectibles and dropped out at 20 to build software.

founders.name: Connor Park
education: University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, studied Computer Science
founders.background_notes: YC bio says he has been building since age 7.

competitors.name: August
competitors.what: AI platform for midsize law firms
competitors.funding_then: 7M seed led by NEA and Pear VC, August 2025

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents that operate legacy software and websites like a person need reliable browser and computer use, with hard parts in robustness, but the building blocks were available from frontier models.

defensibility.rationale: Workflows tuned to each customer and trust with small firms help, but many funded startups and general agent platforms address the same law firm and clinic back office work.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or shutdown found as of 2026-11.

market_need_then: The YC launch post claims thousands of hours of work automated for small businesses, and the website lists several law firm customer stories; seed funding for law firm back office AI was active in 2025 and 2026.

branding.domain_note: Uses withasync.com; async.com belongs to a different company, formerly Podcastle, which rebranded to Async.

identity.voice_and_tone: plain, outcome focused: Run your business with AI agents; calls to action include a free AI audit

brand_strength.rationale: Early stage with no brand press; the name collides with other companies named Async, including a larger rebranded one at async.com.

outcome_analysis: Async is a two person New York company selling task specific AI agents to law firms and other small service businesses, with named law firm customers on its site and claimed large task volumes. No funding is public and many funded legal AI startups compete, so durability depends on retention and sales efficiency in a fragmented customer base.
notes: Batch conflict: the directory and YC page say Summer 2026 and the company was founded in 2025, while a search summary claimed S25 and the directory launch timestamp is June 2025; not resolved. Legal entity reported as Skope Technologies Inc. by a legal tech directory, unverified. No funding found anywhere. Customers' claims of 15,000 tasks and 100,000 hours are the company's own. Outcome search found no news on this company. The competitor list uses August Aug 2025 because it is the only clearly dated 2025 entry; other results were dated 2026.
